name: relay
description: Personal card/column tracker with a full REST API, MCP server, complete history and agent sign-off. Runs on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your master password for Relay. Used to sign in to the web UI and to create API/agent tokens. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` and keep it somewhere safe.

DB.description: D1 database holding boards, cards and the full change history. Created automatically.
